Mac mini rental in California: a dedicated cloud Mac for Xcode

Reviewed: 2026-11-21 · WodeMac

WodeMac rents physical M6 Mac minis hosted in California. Each machine goes to one customer, stays online 24/7, gives you admin rights and comes with the WodeMac Remote Screen app for access from a computer, phone or iPad. Plans run from $169 a month to $1,723.80 a year (about $143.65 a month), paid upfront for the machine only. Delivery is usually within 24 hours and no later than 3 business days.

A whole Mac, not a shared VM

Each Mac mini is rented to a single customer. It is bare metal, not a virtual machine, and it is never split between customers. The current machine is an M6 Mac mini with a 12-core CPU, 16GB unified memory and 256GB storage, hosted in California and online 24/7. Teams can order several.

You get admin rights, so you can install Xcode, Homebrew, Git and whatever else your project needs. Dedicated does not mean nobody else can ever reach it: WodeMac and the hosting provider keep admin access (via DeskIn) for maintenance. Before putting client code, secrets or business data on it, agree on access, backups and what happens to the data when the rental ends.

What it is for

  • iOS and macOS development: write, build, sign and test apps in Xcode, or use the Mac as a build machine in your CI/CD pipeline, even if your own computer runs Windows or Linux.
  • A US workstation for distributed teams: an always-on Mac in the United States for developing and running software that keeps going after you close your laptop.
  • Education and teams: one identically configured Mac per student or developer, so projects, permissions and environments stay apart.

Under the WodeMac terms and the Apple macOS software license, a rented Mac is for software development and testing. It is not for render farms, bulk account creation, proxies or VPNs. Being hosted in California does not make anyone eligible for a third-party service; use your own accounts and follow each service's terms.

Access and delivery

Every machine comes with the WodeMac Remote Screen app, which opens the full Mac desktop from your computer, phone or iPad. WodeMac helps you remotely with the first login.

Delivery is usually within 24 hours of payment and no later than 3 business days. How the connection feels depends on the distance and network between you and California, so try a real task before moving a whole team over.

Checklist before you order

  1. Pick one real development or build task and decide who signs it off.
  2. Check that a 12-core CPU, 16GB memory and 256GB storage fit your project, dependencies and simulators.
  3. Decide how many Macs you need: per person, per project or per build pipeline.
  4. Check the plan, upfront charge, billing start, renewal and refund terms.
  5. Agree how code, secrets, backups and end-of-rental data are handled.

Questions? Contact WodeMac on WeChat (QR code on the homepage) or at hustyy986@gmail.com.

FAQ

Is the Mac a shared virtual machine?

No. Each physical Mac mini is rented to one customer and is not split between customers. WodeMac and the hosting provider keep admin access for maintenance.

Does it come with Xcode installed?

The WodeMac Remote Screen app is the software guaranteed at delivery. You have admin rights and can install Xcode, Homebrew, Git and other developer tools yourself.

How fast is delivery?

Usually within 24 hours of payment, and no later than 3 business days. WodeMac helps remotely with the first login.

Can I start with one Mac?

Yes. Start with one machine and one real task, check the setup and the connection, then add more Macs for the team if it works.
